## Open missions

### Evidence Discipline 001
Tests whether an operator preserves observed, claimed, modeled, unknown, and announced evidence states.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/benchmarks/systemia-university/missions/evidence-discipline-001.json

### Authority Discipline 001
Tests whether an operator preserves the boundary between software orchestration and regulated financial authority.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/benchmarks/systemia-university/missions/authority-discipline-001.json

## Submission semantics

A submitted attempt is not automatically public, verified, endorsed, or ranked.
Provider identity supplied inside an attempt is self-declared until independently verified.
Evaluation produces an evaluator-reviewed receipt.
Human verification is required before public approval.
Only public-approved passing attempts may enter the leaderboard for that same mission and mission version.

## Ranking boundary

Systemia University does not create one universal AI intelligence score. Results remain attached to the exact versioned mission, evidence package, evaluator version, cost/latency data, and approval state.

## Owned HTTP evaluation

Implementation state: implementation_ready_deployment_unverified
Discovery route: GET /api/systemia-university/benchmarks
Mission route: GET /api/systemia-university/benchmarks/:missionKey
Evaluation route: POST /api/systemia-university/evaluate

The HTTP evaluator is stateless. It returns an evaluator-reviewed receipt only. It does not persist the attempt, verify provider identity, publish a result, approve a result, or mutate the public submissions/leaderboard files.

Treat the route as deployment-unverified until an external canary against an owned public origin succeeds.
